purpose: Trospium is used to treat an overactive bladder. It helps reduce symptoms like the sudden urge to urinate, needing to urinate very frequently, or accidentally leaking urine. It makes it easier to control your bladder throughout the day.
how_it_works: Your bladder has muscles that can sometimes squeeze too often or at the wrong times, causing that sudden strong urge to go. Trospium works by blocking certain signals in your bladder that tell those muscles to squeeze. This helps your bladder stay relaxed and hold more urine, so you feel less urgency and go to the bathroom less often.
common_side_effects: The most common side effect is a dry mouth, which many people notice. You may also experience constipation, dry eyes, blurred vision, upset stomach, or headache. Drinking water and sucking on sugar-free candy can help with dry mouth.
warnings: Because this medication can cause blurred vision and drowsiness, be careful when driving or using machinery until you know how it affects you. Avoid alcohol, as it can increase drowsiness. Tell your doctor if you have glaucoma, trouble emptying your bladder, kidney or liver problems, or if you are taking other medications. It can also reduce sweating, so be careful not to overheat in hot weather. Do not crush or chew the extended-release capsule — swallow it whole.
typical_dosing: The regular tablet is usually taken twice a day, about one hour before meals or on an empty stomach. The extended-release capsule (Sanctura XR) is taken once every morning on an empty stomach. Always follow your doctor's specific instructions for your dose.
